page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c16g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance built on the KVM hypervisor. It features 16 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture with a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio, providing 16 vCPUs. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, translating to 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

Acceleration is delivered via a single integrated NVIDIA P4 GPU featuring 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. This server does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached block storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the hardware profile balances dedicated compute resources with entry-level GPU acceleration, making it suitable for workloads that require parallel processing without the expense of high-end accelerator models. Appropriate workloads include machine learning inference, video transcoding, and general-purpose GPU-accelerated computing.
